name: Bessho Shouta
source:
Shouta is the protagonist of the game. He is in love with Nao and is always being teased by Natsuhi.

Nao asked him to be Natsuhi's tutor and he accepted. Now he will be seing Nao more often, which will make the summer very exciting for him.
